cloud_capex_quarterly.name: Capital expenditure reported in SEC filings by 4 major cloud operators, sum per calendar quarter (million USD; payments to acquire PP&E / productive assets as tagged by each filer)
cloud_capex_quarterly.definition_note: Panel: Amazon.com, Inc., Microsoft Corporation, Alphabet Inc., Meta Platforms, Inc.. Values from the SEC XBRL frames API for each calendar quarter, as filed; the sum is arithmetic on public filings. A quarter with fewer than all panel members reported is provisional. Filers whose fiscal quarters do not align with calendar quarters are not included. No evaluation of any company.
cloud_capex_quarterly.causal_note: Capex reported to the SEC is the money actually spent on the physical body of AI (data centers, servers, accelerators) by the largest buyers; it is the public quarterly measure of that flow.

source.name: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, EDGAR XBRL frames API
source.license: Public domain (SEC EDGAR data; fair access policy: identifying User-Agent, <10 req/s)

headline_answer.label: public on-demand H100 price (one provider sample)

faq.q: What is the public on-demand price of an NVIDIA H100 in the U.S. sample?
faq.a: 3.99 USD per GPU-hour on 2026-09-03 (Lambda public pricing page, 8x H100 SXM configuration; one provider is a sample, not a market; weekly first-party snapshot, figure only).

faq.q: How many BIS export-control documents on "advanced computing" were published this month?
faq.a: In 2026-09 (month in progress, value_status provisional): 0 Federal Register documents from the Bureau of Industry and Security matching "advanced computing". The 15 most recent documents are listed in the ledger (checked 2026-09-06). Source: Federal Register API (public domain).

faq.q: How much capital expenditure did the four major cloud operators report?
faq.a: 54,208 million USD in 2026-Q2 (sum over the panel as filed with the SEC via the XBRL frames API; value_status provisional; a quarter with fewer than all panel members reported stays provisional). No evaluation of any company.

faq.q: What is the source and how often is it updated?
faq.a: Federal Register API (daily, counted monthly), Lambda pricing page (weekly), SEC XBRL frames API (quarterly), DOE/LBNL 2024 report as a ledger (irregular). Observation started 2026-09-04. Last updated 2026-09-06 18:01 JST. Machine-readable: https://ai-lifeline.org/us/api/gpu_us.json. Definition: docs/指標定義_US_GPU章.md v1.0.

faq.q: What can this data not tell you?
faq.a: What this chapter cannot say (ledger v1.0, approved 2026-09-05; full text in the method section): Whether GPUs can actually be obtained (no inventory, lead-time or waitlist data is published or observed); Prices actually paid under negotiated or long-term contracts (public list prices only), or the prices of providers outside the panel; Whether any level is high or low, or which company is doing better (nothing here ranks or evaluates a company).
